prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
A few Joplin-area contractors worth getting quotes from are:

- **Business Needs Craftsmanship** — BBB lists it as accredited with an A+ rating and says it handles kitchen and bathroom remodels, additions, decks, and home repairs. **(816) 599-1292**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/general-contractor/business-needs-craftsmanship-0734-1000011969)
- **Harris Renovations, LLC** — HomeAdvisor listings include positive customer feedback for ongoing remodeling projects and communication. Ask whether they take on your specific type of work and request recent local references.
- **Pfeifer Home Remodeling** — HomeAdvisor lists it as serving Joplin, in business since 2007, with positive reviews mentioning punctuality and custom work.
- **GRC General Construction** — BBB lists it as a Joplin-area remodel/general contractor. **(417) 499-7424**.

These are leads, not guarantees. Before hiring, compare at least three written, itemized bids; check recent references and complaint history; confirm insurance and any required permits; and get the schedule, payment milestones, change-order process, and warranty in writing. For a small repair, a specialist may be a better fit than a general remodeler.
